meta.title: Questing: find what's on near you
meta.description: Questing gathers events from clubs, associations, venues and student unions in one place. See what's on near you, follow the organizers you like and find out who's going.

hero.eyebrow: Events near you, in one place
hero.title: Find your next thing to do, and who to do it with.
hero.lead: Questing gathers events from clubs, associations, venues and student unions into one app. See what's on tonight, follow the organizers you like, and find out which friends are going.
hero.note: On the web now. iPhone and Android apps are on their way.

who.title: For anyone with a free evening
who.lead: Questing isn't only for students. If something's happening near you, from a pub quiz to a choir concert to your guild's party, it belongs here.
who.everyone.title: Anyone looking for something to do
who.everyone.body: New in town, or tired of the same weekend? See what's on tonight, this weekend or for free, on a list or a map, and add it to your calendar in a tap.
who.students.title: Students
who.students.body: Your guild's parties, sports clubs and career fairs, next to everything else in town. Verify your student email to see events meant only for your university.
who.organizers.title: Organizers
who.organizers.body: Clubs, associations, venues, student unions and anyone who hosts: put your events where people are already looking, and keep everyone who's coming up to date.
features.title: Everything about going out, in one app
features.nearby.title: Near you
features.nearby.body: Events around you on a list or a map, nearest first. Choose how far you'll go, or look around another town before you visit.
features.follow.title: Follow what you like
features.follow.body: Follow people, clubs and venues. Their events and posts land in your Following feed, and you can be told when they announce something new.
features.friends.title: See who's going
features.friends.body: Say you're going or interested, see which friends are going too, and ask the organizer questions right on the event page.
features.reminders.title: Never miss it
features.reminders.body: A reminder before it starts, one tap to add it to your calendar, and if you like, a weekly email of what's coming up.
features.privacy.title: Your privacy, your call
features.privacy.body: Make your account private, block or mute anyone, and download or delete your data whenever you want.
features.languages.title: In Finnish, Swedish and English
features.languages.body: Questing speaks your language, and so do its emails and notifications.
organizers.title: Get your events in front of people nearby
organizers.lead: Whether you run a guild, a choir, a climbing gym or a bar with a Thursday quiz, Questing helps people find your events and keeps them coming back. It's free.
organizers.publish: Publish events with a cover picture, tickets or a price, an age limit, and a capacity with a waiting list.
organizers.team: Run your organization together, with members and roles, and host events jointly with other organizations.
organizers.import: Already keep a calendar? Link it, and Questing keeps your events in sync.
organizers.reach: Message everyone who's coming, and ask for feedback after the event.
organizers.insights: See views, sign-ups and new followers on your dashboard, and show your upcoming events on your own website.
organizers.verified: Official organizations get a verified badge, so people know it's really you.
closing.title: Ready for your next quest?
closing.body: Signing up is free and takes a minute. Or have a look around first.
